action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User requested to remove (not replace) the Action Camera from the order. The assistant attempted to call modify_pending_order_items with item_ids and an empty new_item_ids list.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: Policy prohibits direct removal of an item from a pending order without replacement by another variant of the same product. The attempted action tried to remove an item without specifying a replacement, violating policy.
action_legality_checks.correct_action: Inform the user that direct removal is not supported and offer to exchange the item for another variant.

action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action. The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation. After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled'.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: Order #W9348897 was pending. The user confirmed cancellation and selected 'no longer needed' as the reason.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: All policy requirements for cancelling a pending order were met: order status was pending, user confirmed the action and provided an acceptable reason.
